name: Real crypto charts and preserved scale controls
covers: public real crypto quotes and history
description: Checks real crypto data reaches the original chart without removing its controls.
steps: Open Charts and select BTCUSDT on the 1h timeframe.
Verify a real price and candles load; open and close the indicator picker.
Use Y +, Y − and Auto scale, then scroll the right price axis.
Return Home and move the pointer across the trading background.
Select AAPL on the 1D timeframe and verify daily candles and an Alpha Vantage daily-close source date.
expected: The original logo and controls remain visible; candles and a real source label appear, scale controls work, and the background reacts to pointer movement. AAPL daily candles use real Alpha Vantage history and are not labeled live.

name: Preserved Terminal saves AvScript work
description: Checks the original code workflow remains intact alongside the additive Gemini entry point.
steps: Open Terminal and create a script named Restored QA Script.
Enter print("Avenir restored"); and save the script.
Open Strategies and verify the script is listed.
Reload and reopen Strategies, then open Terminal and choose Ask Gemini.
expected: The script persists and Ask Gemini opens a separate panel without replacing the Terminal.

name: Account validation and provider authorization on mobile
description: Checks account forms are usable and invalid credentials cannot create sessions or save provider keys.
steps: Open Gemini and select Account.
Leave the email and password empty, then choose Sign in to check local required-field validation.
Verify a useful validation error.
Open Connections, enter a placeholder API key and attempt Save key while signed out.
expected: Account validation and sign-in-required feedback appear; the original page remains intact and no provider key is claimed saved.

name: Original calendar persistence and real community guard
description: Checks actual user events persist while unauthenticated community writes are blocked.
steps: Open Calendar and add an event called Restored Session Review on the selected date.
Reload and revisit the same selected date.
Open Community and attempt to post a titled idea while signed out.
expected: The calendar event remains visible; the Community form retains its original layout and posting requires sign-in without inventing a post.

name: Gemini chat and background task permission boundaries
covers: shared daily quota and unavailable subscription feedback
description: Checks the new assistant and automation controls fail honestly before keys/accounts are configured.
steps: Open Gemini Chat, enter Write an EMA crossover in AvScript, and select Write code mode.
Attempt to Send while signed out and verify sign-in feedback.
Open Automate, enter a task name and instructions, and attempt Save task.
Close Gemini and open Options without a stock options data connection.
Open Connections and inspect the Alpha Vantage dataset selector and daily allowance status. Choose NEWS_SENTIMENT and Load dataset.
expected: Chat and task creation require sign-in; no generated code or task success is fabricated, and the original Options tools remain visible with an honest unavailable-data state. Alpha Vantage shows actual news data or an explicit provider/quota error, and never claims missing data was loaded.
